answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume without buffer, continuity is the binding constraint. The incumbent has documented stable integration and uninterrupted scheduled deliveries, while the lower-cost vendor’s record supports cost and rapid onboarding but does not establish capacity or delivery performance under this utilization level. Renewal does not satisfy the mandated spend reduction, so the budget and future sourcing-value risk is explicitly flagged for the next review.
